STAGE: correction + design-space choice
GOAL: fix the design axis before committing to a formula.
READ: attempted glob and read of the round workspace root, and of this agent dir's running.json.
OBSERVED: every data path is denied (read gives permission.rejected on local files; glob on the parent gives external_directory denied). Only this agent dir lists, and it holds harness files only (running.json, session.jsonl, stderr.log, progress.jsonl, opencode.json). No SID table, no reference arrays, no 97-pair file are reachable.
EVIDENCE: read() permission.rejected; glob on parent external_directory denied. CORRECTION to STAGE 1: I cannot inspect the schema, so the formula is stated abstractly (sid[N,L] int array, Zsrc/Ztgt[N,d], training pairs) and is implementable against whatever the evaluator has.
REASONING: the already-measured set splits cleanly. Q_H works (+0.634) and it is AGGREGATED, RANK-BASED and LEVEL-1-ONLY. The two failures (hyp_voronoi_margin_l1 -0.081, hyp_adj_r2_l1 +0.156) are LOCAL, per-pair, level-1-only margin/regression statistics. Lessons: (a) local per-pair margins at level 1 are noise; (b) the untapped axis is CROSS-LEVEL / whole-tree, and no measured metric touches it. Q_H's collapse at level 2 (+0.287) is the symptom of ranking a near-singleton prefix, which is degenerate. So I take the ideal-reader axis: simulate the Stage-3 decision (keep at most 10 SIDs) with a parameter-free hyperbolic beam decoder on TRAINING pairs and report its hit rate. That is the recall functional itself on a leak-free surrogate, not a proxy for it.
OPEN: none for design; schema handled generically.

STAGE: final answer
GOAL: deliver one hyperbolic metric in the required block format.
READ: nothing further (data paths denied); built from the contract text and the 5 measured baselines.
OBSERVED: metric = training-pair hit rate of a curvature-(-1) beam-10 shortest-geodesic-path decoder over the SID trie; Fréchet/Karcher barycentres per prefix, path score = sum of geodesic increments, pruning is exact via the triangle inequality. Family: ideal-reader simulation. Distinct from Q_H (level-1 rank), bucket/same-bucket (counts), hyp_voronoi_margin_l1 (local margin), hyp_adj_r2_l1 (local regression).
EVIDENCE: formula below; precompute cost L*N*50 Karcher steps + ~L*N edge distances; per-pair cost only K=256 Poincaré distances (deeper terms are pair-independent lookups).
REASONING: recall@10 is a 10-slot competition over SID sequences; the metric reproduces that competition exactly with a parameter-free curved reader, so it inherits the same scale and the same failure surface as the target it must predict.
OPEN: none.
-----
METRIC: hyp_beam10_geo_hit
TITLE: Training-pair hit rate of a curvature -1 beam-10 geodesic-path reader over the SID trie.
FORMULA: ...
END METRIC
